title: Senior Engineer - AI / ML
description:
AI/ML Senior Engineer 
 Experience Level: 5+ Years 
 Location: Chennai 
 Full Time 
 Role Overview 
We are seeking a high-ownership, hands-on AI / LLM Senior Engineer to drive the technical execution of our core AI platforms. In this role, you will bridge deep architectural vision with direct code-level execution.
You will collaborate with an agile engineering pod building enterprise-grade Agentic Workflows, Knowledge Graphs, and AI Security Safeguards. If you are driven by passion and innovation, determined to bend the limits to build something truly transformative this role is for you.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Hands-On Agentic & Knowledge Systems Development:
 Architect & Code: Build multi-modal LLM workflows and autonomous agentic systems using modern orchestration frameworks.
 Knowledge Layer Integration: Implement knowledge graphs, dynamic ontologies, and advanced vector retrieval strategies (Hybrid Search, GraphRAG, Re-ranking) that go beyond standard naive RAG.
 AI Security & Guardrails: 
 Deploy active safeguards against prompt injection, model jailbreaks, hallucination, and data leakage using core AI Security principles.
 Production MLOps, Eval & PerformanceLLM Ops: Build automated pipelines for continuous model evaluation (e.g., RAGAS, TruLens), dynamic prompt versioning, and latency tracking.
 Cost & Throughput Optimization: Optimize token consumption, context window management, caching, and model inference costs across multi-cloud deployments.
 Observability: 
 Monitor model drift, data distribution shifts, and edge-case execution in live enterprise production environments.
 Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and client teams to resolve complex edge cases and accelerate feature delivery.
 Serve as a technical mentor, elevating team execution standards and unblocking complex algorithmic or system challenges daily.
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience: 5+ years of core software engineering experience, including 3+ years specifically architecting and delivering AI/ML or LLM-based products into production.
 Leadership: Proven track record leading agile pods, conducting technical design reviews, and mentoring developers.
 Education: Master’s in computer science, Data Science, AI, or equivalent practical experience demonstrated through shipped products or open-source contributions and professional certifications in AWS/GCP/Oracle/Claude is mandatory.
 Strong technical articulation and communication skills to engage with technical stakeholders, understand requirements, and present engineering solutions cleanly.
 Technical Stack Requirements: 
 Languages & Core CS: Strong mastery of Python (FastAPI, PyDantic, Asyncio) with familiarity in TypeScript, Go, or Java.
 Agentic Frameworks & AI Stack: Hands-on experience with modern LLM orchestration tools (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex), PyTorch, Hugging Face,and major LLM Provider APIs.
 Vector Engines & Knowledge Graphs: Direct working experience with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate) and Knowledge Graph technologies (Neo4j, RDF/Ontologies).
 AI Security & Guardrails: Familiarity with adversarial prompt testing, red teaming concepts, and guardrail implementation.
 MLOps & Infra: Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, MLflow, Weights & Biases, and serverless AI infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure.

Key Skills: TypeScript,Python,Java,Go,AI,ML,Artificial Intelligence,Golang

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Non IT
description:
Position: Talent Acquisition Specialist Company: APTO MANAGEMENT SERVICES
 Location: Noida - WFO Only 
 Experience: Minimum 3+ Years
 Industry: Recruitment Consulting / Executive Search
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Role: Team Management + Client Management + Revenue & P&L Ownership + Individual Contributor (IC) 
 About the Role 
 APTO MANAGEMENT SERVICES is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist with a strong background in reputed Recruitment Consulting / Executive Search firms . 
 The role requires a technically sound recruitment professional with strong expertise in Non-IT hiring , client management, team leadership, revenue generation, and P&L management. The position will also include an Individual Contributor (IC) component, requiring the incumbent to personally handle critical, niche, and senior-level mandates. 
 Key Industry Exposure 
 Candidates should have strong recruitment experience across multiple core/non-IT sectors, preferably: 
 Civil Construction & Infrastructure Real Estate Oil & Gas Petrochemical Power Transmission Engineering & Manufacturing Renewable Energy 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Recruitment Delivery & Executive Search 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for mid, senior, niche, and leadership-level positions. Independently handle critical and technical mandates as an Individual Contributor (IC) . Conduct market mapping, talent identification, headhunting, screening, and candidate assessment. Demonstrate strong understanding of technical roles across core engineering and infrastructure sectors. Drive timely closures while maintaining the quality of shortlisted candidates. 
 Client Management & Business Growth 
 Manage existing clients and build strong relationships with HR Heads, CHROs, Business Heads, and senior stakeholders. Understand client businesses, organizational structures, technical requirements, and hiring priorities. Conduct client meetings, requirement discussions, reviews, and recruitment strategy discussions. Identify opportunities for account expansion, new mandates, and additional business. Maintain high standards of client servicing and relationship management. 
 Revenue Generation & P&L Management 
 Take ownership of recruitment revenue and assigned business targets. Drive revenue through successful closures, account growth, and new business opportunities. Manage and monitor the P&L of the assigned team/business vertical. Track productivity, closures, billing, revenue realization, and overall business performance. Develop strategies to improve profitability and recruitment productivity. 
 Team Management 
 Lead,mentor, and manage a recruitment team. Allocate mandates and monitor recruiters' performance, productivity, and closures. Guide the team on sourcing strategies, technical screening, headhunting, and candidate engagement. Conduct regular reviews and ensure achievement of individual and team targets. 
 Candidate Profile 
 Minimum 8+ years of recruitment experience , preferably with a reputed Recruitment Consulting or Executive Search firm. Strong Non-IT recruitment background is essential. Demonstrated experience in core sectors such as Construction, Infrastructure, Real Estate, Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power Transmission,Engineering/Manufacturing, or Renewable Energy. Technically sound with the ability to understand complex and niche hiring requirements. Strong experience in Client Management, Team Management, Revenue Generation, and P&L Management . Hands-on recruitment capabilities with willingness to operate as an IC for critical assignments. Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder-management, and leadership skills. Target-oriented, commercially driven, and focused on revenue and business growth. 
 Background Requirement 
 Candidates should come from a Non-IT Recruitment / Executive Search background . 
 Profiles primarily experienced in IT Recruitment or US/UK Staffing are outside the scope of this requirement and need not apply. 

 If interested, Pls share your CV at info@aptoservices.com / Whatsapp 9958577165 

 Regards Team HR
